projects.name: SunZia Transmission project
projects.location: central New Mexico to south-central Arizona
projects.quote: The SunZia Transmission project is designed to transmit 3,000 megawatts of electricity generated by the SunZia Wind project on an approximately 550-mile, primarily bi-directional, +/-525 kV high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission line from central New Mexico to south-central Arizona, facilitating the transportation of • renewable energy to the western United States.

projects.name: SunZia Wind project
projects.location: Lincoln, Torrance and San Miguel Counties in New Mexico
projects.quote: Located in Lincoln, Torrance and San Miguel Counties in New Mexico, the SunZia Wind project is a 3,500-megawatt wind generation facility designed to generate enough electricity to power the needs of more than 3 million consumers.
